DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五年後の自分に手紙を書きました。封筒に五年後の日付を書いて、今日こちらに預けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五年後の自分宛ての手紙を未来の日付付きで今日預けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote a letter to myself five years from now. Can I put a date five years ahead on the envelope and leave it with you today?
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can leave a letter to your future self today with a date five years ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日付を書くことだけでは、お預かりする期間の指定にはなりません。五年後に読むため、こちらで保管してほしいということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Writing a date alone doesn't specify how long we'll hold it. Do you want us to store it so you can read it in five years?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。今届く手紙ではなく、五年後に読めるように保管してから送ってほしいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今の配達ではなく五年間保管後に発送してほしい意図を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Rather than having it delivered now, I thought you could store it and send it so I can read it five years from now.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you want dispatch after five years' storage, rather than delivery now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この窓口では、そのように五年間保管してから発送するサービスは扱っていません。今日は普通の手紙として出すことをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This desk doesn't offer a service of storing a letter for five years before sending it. Would you like to send it as a normal letter today?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら今日は出しません。今届くと目的が変わるので、手紙を持ち帰って、自分で保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長期保管を扱わないと聞き郵送を取りやめ自宅保管を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't send it today. Delivery now would change its purpose, so I'll take the letter home and store it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: On hearing long-term storage is unavailable, cancel mailing and choose home storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。封筒はお返しします。宛名欄に書いた日付も、ご自分用のメモだったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I'll return the envelope. The date in the addressee field was a note for yourself too, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で保管する封筒に「五年後に開ける」と書き直します。住所も五年後には変わるかもしれないので、送る準備はいったんやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒の日付を自分の開封用メモに直し将来の住所は未定なので発送準備をやめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll rewrite the envelope I keep at home to say open in five years. My address may change in five years too, so I'll stop preparing to send it for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change the envelope date into a personal opening note and stop sending preparations because your future address is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。今回は郵送のお申し込みはありません。ほかに聞いておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. There is no mailing application this time. Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大丈夫です。家の書類箱に入れて、開ける日を予定表にも残します。預けられると思い込んでいたので、出す前に聞けてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加の質問はなく書類箱に保管して開封日を予定表に残す計画と相談への感想を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, that's fine. I'll put it in my document box at home and note the opening day on my calendar too. I had assumed I could leave it here, so I'm glad I asked before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have no further questions, describe document-box storage and a calendar opening note, and give your thoughts on the advice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご相談ありがとうございました。手紙と封筒をお持ち帰りください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-SAKATA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for asking. Please take the letter and envelope home. Take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。体験のお手伝いはありますか。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the activity?

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駒に文字を書き始めたいのですが、練習紙と作品の向きが違って見えます。筆を入れる前に置き方を見てください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駒に書く前に練習紙と作品の向きの違いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to start writing on the game piece, but the practice paper and the piece seem to face different ways. Please check the placement before I put the brush to it.
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before writing on the piece, discuss the different orientations of the practice paper and actual piece. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 練習紙の上には、どの辺が上になる印がありますか。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-03.translation: On the practice paper, what mark shows which edge is the top?

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三角の先が上になっています。でも作品の駒は先を自分の方へ向けて置いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙の先は上だが作品の先を自分側へ向けたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-04.translation: The triangular tip is at the top. But I placed the actual piece with its tip toward me.
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the paper's tip is at the top but you pointed the actual piece toward yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作品の先も練習紙と同じ向きにして、文字の上下を合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's point the actual piece the same way as the practice paper and align the top and bottom of the lettering.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先を向こう側へ直しました。紙の文字を写す時に、駒そのものを回して楽に書こうとしていたので気をつけます。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 作品の先を向こうへ直し書きやすさで回転させないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've turned the tip away from me. I was about to rotate the piece itself to make copying the paper's lettering easier, so I'll be careful.
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point the actual piece away and say you will not rotate it for writing convenience. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 乾く前に回すと、書いた所へ触れてしまうこともあります。紙の置き場所も決めておきましょう。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-07.translation: Turning it before it dries may cause you to touch the writing too. Let's decide where to put the paper as well.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 練習紙を駒の下から横へ移します。書き終わるまで、紙を引いて駒まで動かさないようにします。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習紙を下から横へ移し紙を引いて駒を動かさないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll move the practice paper from under the piece to beside it. Until I've finished writing, I'll avoid pulling the paper and moving the piece too.
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move the practice paper from beneath to beside the piece and avoid moving the piece by pulling the paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では最初の一画を、練習した向きで確認してください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then check the first stroke in the orientation you practiced.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先を上にした文字の向きと、横の練習紙を確かめました。途中で作品を回さず、一画目から書きます。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 文字の上下と紙の位置を確認し回さず一画目を書くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the lettering with the tip at the top and the practice paper beside it. I'll start with the first stroke without rotating the piece partway through.
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the lettering orientation and paper position and write the first stroke without rotating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。慌てずに進めてください。仕上がったら乾かす場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-YGT-TENDO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take your time. When you've finished, we'll show you the drying place.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご利用中に何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help with during your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同行している姉と連絡がつきません。受付へ来てほしいのですが、私的な用件なので、詳しい事情を放送せず呼び出せるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉への館内呼出しで私的事情を放送せず受付集合を頼みたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can't contact my older sister who's with me. I'd like her to come to reception, but it's personal, so I'd like to ask whether she can be paged without broadcasting the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss paging your sister to reception without broadcasting private circumstances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お姉さまのお名前で受付へ来るよう案内したいのですね。携帯では連絡できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you'd like an announcement using your sister's name asking her to come to reception. Were you able to contact her by mobile?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯へはメッセージを送りましたが、まだ返事がありません。館内放送でメッセージの内容まで読む必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯連絡済み未返信でメッセージ全文の放送不要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've sent her a message, but there's no reply yet. There's no need to read the message contents over the public-address system.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that a mobile message is unanswered and broadcasting its full contents is unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 呼出し方法を担当と確認します。受付へ来てほしいという案内だけでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the paging method with the staff member. Is simply asking her to come to reception enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。それで私と会えます。個人的な相談の内容は、姉がここへ来てから私が話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 集合案内だけで会えて用件は姉到着後自分から話すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. That will let her meet me. I'll explain the personal matter myself after she comes here.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the meeting announcement is enough and you will explain the matter after your sister arrives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同じお名前の方と区別する情報が必要な場合は、担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If information is needed to distinguish her from someone with the same name, the staff member will check.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。家族の事情を詳しく説明して区別するのではなく、必要な呼出し情報を担当へだけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同名識別も家庭事情放送でなく必要情報を担当へだけ伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Rather than distinguishing her by explaining family circumstances in detail, I'll give only the necessary paging information to the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give only necessary identifying information to staff rather than broadcasting family circumstances for same-name distinction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内できる呼出し方法をご確認ください。呼出しをしても、すぐに応答があるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the available paging method. Even with an announcement, there may not be an immediate response.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付で待ちます。放送を繰り返して私的な内容を足さず、来ない場合は次にどう連絡するか担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付待機し私的内容を追加せず未応答時は次の連絡を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait at reception. I won't repeat the announcement while adding private details; if she doesn't come, I'll ask the staff member how to contact her next.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait at reception without adding private details and discuss further contact if there is no response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。呼出しの担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you with the paging staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with anything in the orchard?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 食べた果物の種を片付けたいです。収穫用のかごしか手元にないので、入れる前に回収する場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 食べた種を収穫かごへ入れず回収場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to clear away the seeds from fruit I've eaten. I only have the harvesting basket with me, so before putting them in, please tell me the collection place.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to dispose of eaten-fruit seeds without putting them in the harvesting basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: かごには、まだ食べていない果物が入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the basket contain fruit that hasn't been eaten yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、家族が取った分があります。種を一緒に入れると、どれが食べた残りか分からなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: かごに家族の未食果物があり種と混ぜたくないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, there is fruit my family picked. If I put seeds in with it, we might not know which are eaten leftovers.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the basket contains your family's uneaten fruit and you do not want to mix in seeds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食べ残し用の容器をご案内します。収穫用のかごとは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll show you the container for food remains. Please keep it separate from the harvesting basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今は小さい紙にまとめています。木の下へ捨てず、このまま指定の容器へ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 種は紙でまとめ木下へ捨てず指定容器へ運ぶと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I've gathered them on a small piece of paper for now. I won't throw them under a tree; I'll take them to the designated container like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Gather the seeds on paper and take them to the designated container instead of throwing them under a tree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同行の方にも容器の場所をお伝えください。かごの中身を捨てる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell your companions where the container is too. There's no need to throw away the basket contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族には種だけ別の容器へ、と伝えます。まだ食べていない物まで残り物だと思って捨てないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ種だけ別回収と伝え未食果物まで捨てないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my family only the seeds go in the separate container. I'll avoid treating uneaten fruit as leftovers and throwing it away too.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell your family seeds are collected separately and avoid throwing away uneaten fruit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手を拭く物や洗う場所についても、園内の案内を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also check the orchard information for hand-wiping supplies and washing places.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 種を分けて片付けてから、手をきれいにする場所も確認します。収穫かごは食べていない果物だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 種の回収後に手を清潔にする場所を確認し収穫かごを分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: After separating and clearing the seeds, I'll check where to clean my hands too. I'll keep the harvesting basket for only uneaten fruit.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After seed disposal, check where to clean your hands and keep the harvesting basket separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。こちらが回収場所です。どうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here's the collection point. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お部屋探しで何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you look for a room?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この部屋を内見したいです。写真では今の机が入りそうですが、広く写っているので、実際の寸法を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 広角写真だけで机が入ると決めず内見で実寸を測りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to view this room. The photo makes it look as though my current desk will fit, but it's photographed to look spacious, so I'd like to check the actual dimensions.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Avoid deciding a desk fits from a wide-angle photo and ask to measure actual dimensions during a viewing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机の大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know your desk's size?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅が百二十センチ、奥行きが六十センチです。窓の下へ置きたいですが、写真だけでは壁の長さが分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 机幅百二十奥行六十で窓下壁長が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's one hundred twenty centimeters wide and sixty deep. I'd like it under the window, but the photo alone doesn't tell me the wall length.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the desk's width of one hundred twenty and depth of sixty and explain the window-wall length is unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内見で置きたい場所を測りましょう。机を置いた後の通路も考える必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's measure the place you want it during the viewing. You also need to consider the passage after placing the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、椅子を引くと奥行きが増えます。机の天板が入るだけで、使えると判断しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 椅子を引く幅も含め天板が入るだけで利用可能としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, pulling out the chair needs more depth. I'll avoid judging it usable just because the tabletop fits.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Include chair pull-out space rather than treating tabletop fit alone as usability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 窓や扉の開閉を妨げないかも確認してください。今の家具を必ず使いたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check whether it obstructs windows or doors opening too. Do you definitely want to use your existing furniture?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: できれば使いたいです。ただ、向きを変えた場合の通路も測って、無理なら小さい机を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 向き違いでも通路を測り難しければ小机を考えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If possible, yes. However, I'll measure the passage with the desk turned another way too, and consider a smaller desk if it's difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Measure passage space in another orientation and consider a smaller desk if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では内見時に寸法のメモをお持ちください。写真の印象と実際の配置を分けて見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please bring your dimension notes to the viewing. You can separate the photographic impression from the actual layout.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 机の寸法と椅子を引く幅をメモします。二つの置き方で扉と通路を確認してから、この部屋を検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 寸法メモで二配置の扉と通路を確認後に物件を検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll note the desk dimensions and chair pull-out space. I'll consider this room after checking the doors and passage with two layouts.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use dimension notes to check doors and passage in two layouts before considering the property. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。内見の日時をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain the viewing dates and times.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。明細について何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about the statement?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家計のメモにカードの金額を写したいです。買った時の全額と、今月払う分割分が両方あるので、二重に数えていないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入全額と分割月額を両方足した家計記録を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to copy my card amounts into my household-budget notes. There is both the full purchase amount and this month's installment, so I'd like to check whether I'm counting twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a household record adding both the full purchase price and monthly installment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの資料に、それぞれの金額がありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の控えには購入全額、カードの案内には今月の支払予定額があります。両方を今月の支出に書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店舗控え総額とカード今月予定額を同じ月欄へ写したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The store receipt has the full purchase amount, and the card notice has this month's planned payment. I wrote both as this month's expenses.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain entering the store total and card's planned monthly amount in the same month's field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入した総額と月々の支払いを分けて整理しましょう。契約内容はカードの担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's organize the purchase total separately from the monthly payments. You can check the contract details with the card staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ買い物の総額と今月分を別の買い物と思っていたわけではありません。書く欄を分ける必要があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同一買い物の総額と月払いを記録上区別する必要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I didn't think the full amount and this month's portion were separate purchases. I need separate fields for recording them, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the need to distinguish the same purchase's total and monthly payment in your records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 家計の整理方法と契約上の支払額を混同しないようにしてください。今月の金額は確定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't confuse household bookkeeping with the amount payable under your contract. Is this month's amount finalized?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ予定の表示です。確定した請求を確認し、ほかの利用分や手数料も含むか担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定額を確定請求で確認し他利用や手数料を担当へ尋ねると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It still says planned. I'll check the finalized bill and ask the staff whether it also includes other card use or fees.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the planned amount against the final bill and ask about other purchases or fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その資料をそろえてカードの案内窓口へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please gather those documents and consult the card information desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 総購入額は別の記録へ残します。今月欄には確定した請求を確認して書き、同じ全額をもう一度加えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 総額は別記録で今月は確定請求を確認し二重加算しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the total purchase amount in a separate record. In this month's field, I'll check and enter the finalized bill, without adding the same full amount again.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the total in a separate record, check this month's final bill and avoid double addition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。カードの問い合わせ先をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you the card inquiry contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。観戦用品で何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What spectator equipment are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遠い席から選手を見たいので、双眼鏡を探しています。この見本をのぞくと丸い景色が二つに分かれます。使い方を教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遠い席で使う双眼鏡の見本が二つの丸に見えるため使い方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for binoculars to see players from a distant seat. Looking through this sample, I see two separate circular views. Could you teach me how to use them?
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to use binoculars for distant seats because the sample shows two circles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見本の左右の間隔を、ご自身の目の幅に合わせてみましょう。強く曲げず、この部分をゆっくり動かしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's adjust the sample's left-right spacing to your eye width. Don't bend it forcefully; move this part slowly.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 近づけたら一つの丸になりました。次は看板の文字がぼやけるので、どこで焦点を合わせるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 幅調整で一つに見えたと報告しぼやけた看板の焦点調整方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bringing them closer made it one circle. Now the sign's lettering is blurry, so I'd like to know where to adjust the focus.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report seeing one circle after width adjustment and ask how to focus the blurry sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中央の輪で調整できます。こちらの案内に沿って、遠くの看板を見ながら少しずつ回してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can adjust with the central wheel. Follow these instructions and turn it little by little while looking at the distant sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 文字が読めました。友人にも貸したいのですが、私の設定のまま渡さず、友人自身にも幅と焦点を合わせてもらうのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 文字が読めたと報告し共有時は友人自身の幅と焦点に合わせると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read the lettering. I'd like to lend them to my friend too, so instead of passing them on with my settings, I should have my friend adjust their own width and focus, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report readable lettering and confirm your friend should adjust width and focus for themselves when sharing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ご自身で持って使う時の重さも、見本で確かめてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please also use the sample to check the weight when holding and using it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 片手だと揺れるので、両手で持ちます。重さは大丈夫です。首に掛けるひもの長さも、購入前に見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両手なら使える重さだと伝え付属ひもの長さを購入前に確かめたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It shakes in one hand, so I'll hold it with both. The weight is fine. Before buying, I'd like to check the length of the neck strap too.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the weight works with both hands and ask to check the included strap length before purchase. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ひも付きのこちらの商品です。長さの調整方法と値札をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the product with a strap. Please check the length-adjustment method and price tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 長さの調整もできました。この一つを買います。二重に見えた原因を不良品だと思って交換を頼む前に、使い方を聞けてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 幅と焦点とひもを調整できた見本の商品一つを値札確認後購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've adjusted the length too. I'll buy one of these. I'm glad I asked how to use it before deciding the double view meant it was faulty and asking for an exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the price, buy one of the sample product whose width, focus and strap you could adjust. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。双眼鏡一つをお包みします。どうぞ観戦をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll wrap one pair of binoculars. Enjoy watching the game.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with anything in the zoo?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 動物の鳴き声を携帯に録音しました。見えない動物を呼べるかと思いましたが、流す前に音の扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 録音した鳴き声で動物を呼ぶ前に音の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I recorded an animal call on my phone. I thought it might call an animal I can't see, but before playing it, I'd like to ask how sound should be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sound before using a recorded call to summon an animal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、携帯の音は出していませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your phone isn't playing sound now, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ再生していません。録音したのはさきほど聞こえた音ですが、動物に向けて流してよいかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: まだ再生しておらず録音音声を動物へ流す可否不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct, I haven't played it yet. I recorded the sound I heard a little earlier, but I don't know whether it's okay to play it toward the animals.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not played it and do not know whether recorded sound may be played toward animals. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 録音音声で動物の反応を引き出す行為はせず、観覧の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't use recorded audio to provoke an animal's response; follow the viewing instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。音で呼ばず、見える場所へ出てくるまで静かに見ます。鳴かなかったからといって何度も再生しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音で反応を求めず静かに観覧し再生を繰り返さないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't call it with sound; I'll watch quietly until it comes somewhere visible. I won't play the recording repeatedly because it doesn't call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Observe quietly without seeking a response through sound or repeated playback. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で録音を聞き返す場合も、周囲の迷惑にならないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even when listening to your own recording, please avoid disturbing those around you.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 園内では今は聞き返しません。帰ってから、撮った写真と時間を照らし合わせて自分の記録を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 園内では聞き返さず帰宅後写真時刻と記録を整理すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't listen again in the zoo now. After going home, I'll compare the photos and times and organize my own records.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not replay it in the zoo; organize records with photo times after returning home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 録音した音がどの動物のものか、必ずしも分からないこともあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It isn't always possible to know which animal made the recorded sound.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、近くにいた動物の声だと決めつけず、聞こえた時刻の記録として残します。動物へ音を向けることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 特定動物の声と断定せず聞こえた時刻の記録として残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I won't assume it's the voice of the animal nearby. I'll keep it as a record of the time I heard it. I won't direct sound at the animals.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid declaring a specific animal made the sound and retain it as a record of when it was heard. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。静かに観覧をお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。飲み物のご注文でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help with your drink order?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日はお酒を飲まないので、甘い飲み物がほしいです。この桃の飲み物は、アルコールが入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 酒を飲まないため桃飲料にアルコールがあるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm not drinking alcohol today, so I'd like something sweet. Does this peach drink contain alcohol?
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a peach drink contains alcohol because you are not drinking alcohol. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのページの桃サワーは、お酒を使う商品です。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The peach sour on that page contains alcohol.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前だけ見てジュースだと思っていました。甘いかどうかではなく、ノンアルコールの一覧を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: サワーをジュースと思ったため甘味でなくノンアル一覧を見たいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I looked only at the name and thought it was juice. I'd like to see the nonalcoholic list, rather than choosing by sweetness.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you mistook the sour for juice and want the nonalcoholic list rather than judging by sweetness. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらのページがノンアルコールです。桃のソーダもございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This page is nonalcoholic. We also have peach soda.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 桃のソーダをお願いします。桃サワーとは別の商品として、ノンアルコールで注文したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ノンアル桃ソーダをサワーと別商品として注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Peach soda, please. I'd like to order it as a nonalcoholic product separate from peach sour.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order nonalcoholic peach soda as a different product from the sour. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。サイズは通常のグラスでよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Is the regular glass size okay?

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、一杯だけです。友人も桃サワーを頼むので、同じ名前の省略で二杯とまとめないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人はサワーで自分はソーダ一杯ずつを省略してまとめないと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, just one. My friend is ordering peach sour too, so please don't abbreviate them to the same name and combine them as two glasses.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask not to abbreviate and combine your friend's one sour and your one soda. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お酒の桃サワー一杯と、ノンアルコールの桃ソーダ一杯に分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll confirm them separately: one alcoholic peach sour and one nonalcoholic peach soda.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の分は桃ソーダです。届いた時もどちらか聞いて、甘い味だけで区別しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分のソーダを提供時にも確認し味だけで区別しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Mine is the peach soda. I'll ask which is which when they arrive too, rather than distinguishing them by sweet taste alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your soda when served too and do not identify it by taste alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。提供時に商品名をお伝えしますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-YGT-TENDO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll tell you the product names when serving, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。実習で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with the practical activity?

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 砂糖を量っていますが、レシピの大さじ一杯は山盛りでしょうか。加える前に確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 砂糖を加える前に大さじ一杯が山盛りか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm measuring sugar. Does one tablespoon in the recipe mean a heaped spoon? I'd like to check before adding it.
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before adding sugar, ask whether a tablespoon means a heaped spoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、どの道具で量っていますか。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-03.translation: What tool are you using to measure now?

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 食事用のスプーンで山盛りにしました。でも、台に計量用のスプーンがあることに気づきました。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食事用スプーンで量ったが計量スプーンに気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heaped it onto an eating spoon. But I noticed there are measuring spoons on the counter.
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain measuring with an eating spoon before noticing the measuring spoons. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: レシピの計量には指定の道具を使いましょう。今の砂糖はもう料理に加えましたか。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's use the specified tools for measuring the recipe. Have you already added that sugar to the food?

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ小皿に置いてあるだけです。計量スプーンで量り直して、すり切り一杯にしたいです。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未投入の砂糖を計量スプーンですり切りに量り直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's still only on a small dish. I'd like to remeasure it with a measuring spoon and make it one level spoonful.
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Remeasure the unadded sugar with a level measuring spoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 量り直した分と余った分を区別してください。ほかの材料も、同じ食事用スプーンで量りましたか。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Keep the remeasured amount separate from the excess. Did you measure other ingredients with the same eating spoon too?

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 塩も量りかけましたが、まだ入れていません。砂糖と塩の小皿を入れ替えないよう、名前を付けて量り直します。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未投入の塩も小皿の名前を分けて量り直すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I started measuring salt too, but haven't added it. I'll label the sugar and salt dishes so I don't switch them and remeasure them.
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Label the separate dishes and remeasure the unadded salt too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ではレシピの分量と単位を一つずつ照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then let's compare the recipe quantities and units one by one.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 砂糖は大さじ、塩は小さじですね。計量用の道具とすり切りの量を確認し、余った分まで加えないようにします。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 砂糖大さじ塩小さじを照合し余りを加えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sugar is a tablespoon and salt a teaspoon, right? I'll check the measuring tools and level quantities, and avoid adding the excess too.
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match sugar tablespoon and salt teaspoon and confirm you will not add the excess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。加える前に、量り直した小皿を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-YGT-TSURUOKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Before adding them, let's check the remeasured small dishes together.
